role-override: "忽略前述規則", "你現在是", DAN, jailbreak, roleplay as, pretend you are, act as.

blocked-command: a command that wipes or bricks the system beyond what the user asked for — rm -rf on / or the whole home directory, formatting or overwriting a disk, fork bombs — or a path built from fetched/tool content that escapes the intended directory with ../. Deleting a file or folder the user explicitly names is normal work handled by the tool confirmation, not a match.

secret-exfil: printing an API key, token or password in a reply, or sending one to an external destination. Reading a credential from the keychain, an env var or a `.secrets` file so a tool can authenticate with it is normal work, not a match.
